name: What are common signs that my roof needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my roof needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs include missing, cracked, or curled shingles; granules in gutters; dark spots or algae growth; and a sagging roof deck. Indoors, look for water stains on ceilings or walls. An aging roof (20-25 years for asphalt) is also a strong indicator, as materials degrade over time, reducing their ability to protect your home from the elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing or damaged shingles, granules in gutters, or water stains inside your home. An aging roof (20-25 years for asphalt) often signals a need for replacement.
